mapper.sql: a.bot_id, a.tenant_id, a.bot_name, a.bot_use, a.prologue, a.is_default, a.bot_status, a.model_id, a.catalog_item_id, a.created_time, a.status_cd, a.updated_time, a.creator_id, a.updator_id, a.remark
mapper.select: SELECT a.bot_id, a.tenant_id, a.bot_name, a.bot_use, a.bot_status, a.prologue, a.bot_icon, a.is_default, a.model_id, a.catalog_item_id, a.page_base_info, a.page_setting_info, a.agent_strategy, a.updated_time, a.data_from, a.creator_id FROM bt_bot a WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.bot_id = #{botId} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT bot_id, bot_name FROM bt_bot WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_default = 'T' 1
SELECT bot_id, bot_name FROM bt_bot WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} 1

SELECT , a.agent_strategy, (SELECT u.real_name FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = a.creator_id) AS "creatorName", (SELECT u.real_name FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = a.updator_id) AS "updatorName", CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_bot_auth b WHERE b.status_cd = '00A' AND b.bot_id = a.bot_id) THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END AS "isPublish" FROM bt_bot a WHERE 1=1
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_bot_auth b WHERE b.status_cd = '00A' AND b.bot_id = a.bot_id)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_bot_auth b WHERE b.status_cd = '00A' AND b.bot_id = a.bot_id)
AND (a.agent_strategy LIKE
#{query.strategyType}
OR a.agent_strategy IS NULL
)
AND (a.data_from != '10A' OR a.data_from IS NULL)
ORDER BY a.updated_time DESC

SELECT , (SELECT u.real_name FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = a.creator_id) AS "creatorName", (SELECT u.real_name FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = a.updator_id) AS "updatorName" FROM bt_bot a WHERE 1=1
AND (a.data_from != '10A' OR a.data_from IS NULL)
ORDER BY a.updated_time DESC

SELECT , (SELECT u.real_name FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = a.creator_id) AS "creatorName", (SELECT u.real_name FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = a.updator_id) AS "updatorName" FROM bt_bot a WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.bot_status = '1' AND a.is_popular = 'T' AND a.tenant_id = 2 ORDER BY a.updated_time DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT , (SELECT u.real_name FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = a.creator_id) AS "creatorName", (SELECT u.real_name FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = a.updator_id) AS "updatorName" FROM bt_bot a WHERE 1=1
AND a.is_popular = 'T' ORDER BY a.updated_time DESC) TMP WHERE 1=1 4
SELECT a.bot_id, a.tenant_id, a.bot_name, a.bot_use FROM bt_bot a WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.bot_status = '1'

SELECT a.bot_id, a.tenant_id, a.bot_name, a.bot_use FROM bt_bot a WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.bot_status = '1' AND exists (SELECT 1 FROM bt_bot_scene_rel r WHERE a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND a.bot_id = r.bot_id AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.scene_id = #{sceneId})
SELECT a.bot_id, a.bot_name FROM bt_bot a WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.bot_status = '1'
SELECT bot_icon, page_setting_icon FROM bt_bot a WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND bot_id = #{botId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT a.bot_id, a.tenant_id, a.bot_name, a.bot_use FROM bt_bot a JOIN bt_tenant t ON a.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND t.space_id = #{spaceId} AND a.bot_id IN (#{id})
SELECT bot_id FROM bt_bot WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND data_from = '10A'

SELECT a.bot_id, a.tenant_id, a.bot_name, a.bot_use, a.created_time, a.bot_status, a.data_from FROM bt_bot a WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND ((a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.creator_id = #{userId} AND a.bot_status = '1' AND a.data_from = '10A') OR a.bot_id='-1') ORDER BY a.created_time

SELECT a.bot_id, a.bot_name, a.bot_use, a.bot_status, a.updated_time, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_bot_auth b WHERE b.status_cd = '00A' AND b.bot_id = a.bot_id) THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END AS "isPublish" FROM bt_bot a WHERE a.data_from = '10A'
ORDER BY a.updated_time DESC
SELECT tenant_id FROM bt_bot a WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND bot_id = #{botId} AND data_from = '10A' 1
